project.purpose: Durable semantic re-entry and collaboration persistence; remember claims without promoting them into foreign truth.

kernelLaws: Host owns Host-local identity/revision/persisted bytes, not foreign truth.
Discovery and attention are projections, never priority or execution admission.
Prefer external substrate owners; retain custom code only for irreducible continuity semantics.

externalOwners.capability: MCP protocol / HTTP transport / tool discovery (tools/list)

nonSubstitutions.reason: MCP Tasks extension models asynchronous request execution; Host Work models durable cross-agent semantic continuity.

nextBoundaries.name: client tool-catalog freshness
nextBoundaries.rule: live tools/list is authoritative; do not restore a Host surfaceVersion or parallel Tool catalog

nextBoundaries.name: cross-call friction telemetry
nextBoundaries.rule: measure Agent Tool-call lifecycle outside Host persistence; Host Doctor remains Host-local invariant checking only

nextBoundaries.name: semantic stale/duplicate work judgement
nextBoundaries.rule: Work age and Goal parallelism are observations; semantic abandonment and duplicate-work decisions require current goal evidence.

reopenOnlyFor: material re-entry cost not reducible by preserving a more specific caller-owned coordinate
mature external owner with lower total coupling

semanticAlignment.scope: Current semantic mapping; no deployment claim
retiredVocabulary: Task/Checkpoint/Board referred to retired pre-Social-Work-Fabric modules; current Work snapshots and social journal are not claims of old API compatibility.

consumerCompositions.directConsumer: Authenticated Agent using Gateway official MCP and Host semantic continuity
consumerCompositions.businessScenario: Discover delegated Work without Work subscription; claim/submit; post Topic evidence; disconnect; resume via Attention+Topic; acknowledge both clocks; consumer review and get committed Work

contract.I: typed WorkRef, ActorRef(s), TopicRef, phase action, Work expectedRevision, ClientRequestId, two distinct cursors, authenticated MCP session and policy decision
contract.O: work.currentRevision/Engagement status, Topic message page, Attention reentry, independent ACK receipts, typed failed authorization without Host Work mutation
contract.S: Host PG schema13 WorkSnapshot+Message+Subscription+TopicConsumptionCursor+AttentionCursor; Gateway/Security are external policy and transport owners
contract.pre: Test: real official Gateway/Owner MCP, test-only exact Principal/Actor/Work policy, live disposable PG18; production: real trusted Principal→Actor grant and installed matching releases are mandatory, not proven
contract.post: Review.Accepted commits only with submitted matching claimEpoch/evidence; restarted ClientSession reads actual Work; Topic and Attention acknowledgements progress in separate sequence domains
contract.inv: Only one Work CAS winner per expected revision; forged Actor denied before upstream; Agent cannot infer real external effect from Work/Message; current payload digest and revision remain valid
contract.eff: Only isolated Host PostgreSQL Work, Message, Subscription and Cursor effects; no Runtime Job, production grant, actual Artifact or domain completion
contract.c: UNKNOWN(reason=real Agent p50/p95 latency, tools and token payload under deployed workload unmeasured; obligation=measure at installed consumer)
contract.epsilon: UNKNOWN(reason=installed Security grant, real distinct Principal delegation, production release/failure bound and foreign evidence not verified; obligation=native owner and Agent readback)
contract.unfold: Agent MCP ClientSession → verified Gateway HTTP ingress → test-only Scoped PDP → Gateway Host OwnerEndpoint → real Rust MCP HTTP → PostgreSQL CAS/Message/Cursors → new Agent MCP ClientSession read and ACK

evidence.sourceCut: working-tree candidate; requires exact clean commit and re-verification

releaseBlockers: Gateway and Host installed release currentness
